arguments.value: James J. Brady was a United States district judge for the Middle District of Louisiana, serving from 2000 until his death in 2017 and taking senior status in 2013. Born in St. Louis, Missouri, he earned a B.A. from Southeastern Louisiana College in 1966 and a J.D. from Louisiana State University Law School in 1969. Brady spent more than three decades in private practice in Louisiana and also served on the Louisiana Board of Tax Appeals from 1975 to 1980. In addition, he taught as an adjunct professor at Louisiana State University in several years during the 1980s and 1990s.
